How Does SEO Work in 2026, Including AI Overviews and AI Mode?

Search now includes AI-written answers alongside the familiar list of links. Google's own guidance on AI features says there is no special optimisation required to appear in AI Overviews or AI Mode: a page needs to be indexed and eligible to show a snippet, and the usual SEO fundamentals still apply. In May 2026, Google also clarified that its spam policies cover these AI answers as well.
In practice, that means:

items: Clear, well-structured pages that answer a question directly near the top and in detail below.
Accurate facts with sources, real authors and real business information.
Fast pages whose main content is readable without running scripts.
Genuine reputation: mentions, reviews and links that you have earned.
No tricks: hidden text, mass-produced pages and fake mentions are treated as spam in AI answers too.

main_content.text: We structure pages so they can be quoted accurately by AI systems and still persuade a human visitor to call you.
Which SEO Services Does Our SEO Agency Offer?
Different businesses need different search work. We tailor the plan to how your customers search.
Local SEO Services

Our local SEO services help businesses with a real office, shop, clinic or service area appear in map results and local searches. We optimise your Google Business Profile, fix inconsistent name, address and phone details across the web, build location pages only for places where you genuinely operate, and set up an honest process for asking customers for reviews.

Google's guidelines for business profiles are strict, and we follow them. A virtual office or a rented address where the business does not actually operate is not eligible for a profile. Service-area businesses that visit customers should hide their address and list the areas they serve instead. The business name must match the real-world name used on signage and stationery, without extra keywords or locations. Each location should have only one profile.

As one of the local search engine optimization agencies that also builds websites, we connect your profile, location pages and on-site content so they support each other. If you are looking for a local SEO company in India that will not create fake listings for cities where you have no office, that is exactly how we work.
SEO Services for Business and Small Business SEO Services

Most of our SEO services for business clients are service companies that need steady enquiries: consultants, clinics, manufacturers, contractors, coaching centres and agencies. Our small business SEO services focus on the basics that move the needle fastest: a fast mobile site, one strong page per service, a complete business profile, and content that answers the questions customers ask before they call.
Shopify SEO Services

Shopify stores have their own SEO patterns. Our Shopify SEO services handle product and collection page content, structured data for products, image optimisation, app clean-up for speed, and duplicate URLs created by collections and filters. Shopify generates a default robots.txt that works for most stores, and its documentation allows customising it through a robots.txt.liquid template when a store needs different crawl rules. As a Shopify SEO company with in-house Shopify developers, we make these changes safely in your theme.
SaaS SEO Services

Software companies sell to buyers who research carefully. Our SaaS SEO services build pages for features, use cases, integrations, comparisons and pricing questions, along with documentation and help content that ranks for problem-led searches. We measure success in sign-ups, demo requests and trial-to-paid conversions, not traffic alone.
Organic SEO Services

Organic SEO services focus on unpaid search results across your whole site: technical health, content depth and authority. They suit businesses that want visibility that keeps working when ad budgets pause. Organic SEO takes longer to show results than ads, but the visibility tends to last.
Managed SEO Services

With managed SEO services, we act as your search team. Each month we plan the priorities, carry out the work, report on results and agree the next steps with you. You approve major changes; we handle the rest.
SEO Expert Services and Search Engine Optimisation Consultants

Some companies already have writers and developers and need direction rather than hands. Our SEO expert services provide audits, strategy, training and reviews of your team's work. In this mode, our specialists act as search engine optimisation consultants, and your team carries out the changes.

There are three common ways to get search work done. Each suits a different stage, and an honest SEO agency will tell you when another option fits better.

Organic search and paid search ads both put you in front of people searching on Google, but they behave very differently. Many clients use both, with ads covering gaps while organic visibility matures. As an SEO search agency that also runs ads, we plan them together so you do not pay for clicks you could earn.

main_content.text: What Does an SEO Agency Do in the First 90 Days?
The first three months set the foundation for everything that follows. This is what a typical start looks like with us; the exact order depends on what the audit finds.
Month 1: Audit, Access and Urgent Fixes

We complete the technical audit, set up or check Search Console, Analytics and conversion tracking, and fix anything that blocks indexing, such as wrong noindex tags, broken redirects or blocked resources. We also agree the keyword-to-page map, so every important search term has one owner page on your site.
Month 2: Pages That Matter Most

We improve the pages closest to bringing enquiries: main service or category pages, the home page and pages that already rank on page two. Titles, headings, content depth, internal links and structured data are updated, and your business profile is completed and corrected.
Month 3: Content Gaps and Authority

We publish new pages for important gaps found in the audit, start earning mentions and links through genuine outreach, and review early data together. By the end of the quarter you should see clear technical improvement and early movement in visibility, even if full results take longer.
Throughout, your SEO agency team keeps a shared task list, so you can see what was done, what is next and what is waiting for your approval.
What Affects How Fast Results Arrive?

Google's guide to hiring an SEO suggests asking any provider what results to expect and in what timeframe, rather than accepting a promise. The honest answer depends on a handful of factors, and we explain each one after the audit:

items: Starting point: a site with serious technical problems needs repairs before growth can begin.
Competition: crowded markets with strong, long-established competitors take longer.
Search demand: niche services with few searches can rank sooner but bring fewer visitors.
Publishing pace: how many pages can be improved or added each month.
Approvals: how quickly content and technical changes are signed off.
Reputation: existing reviews, mentions and links give a head start.

main_content.text: We set milestones for each stage, such as fixed indexing errors, improved pages and growing impressions, so you can see progress before enquiries rise.
Measuring Visibility in AI Answers

AI Overviews and AI Mode appear inside Google Search, and Google reports traffic from them within the normal Search Console performance data. We track this alongside regular results, watch which of your pages are linked from AI answers for priority topics, and check how often your brand is mentioned accurately. When an answer gets your details wrong, the fix is usually clearer, better-sourced content on your own site and consistent business information everywhere else, which your SEO agency can put in place.

Every report starts with business results and ends with what we will do next. We agree on the numbers before work begins.

Guaranteed SEO Services: Why We Do Not Offer Them

Many buyers search for guaranteed SEO services, which usually promise a first-page or number-one position for a set of keywords. We understand the appeal, but Google's own guidance on hiring an SEO is direct: "No one can guarantee a #1 ranking on Google." It also warns against anyone claiming a special relationship with Google.

Providers that guarantee rankings often choose easy, low-value keywords, or use tactics that can harm your site later. Instead of a guarantee, we commit to a clear plan, honest reporting, fast fixes and work that follows Google's published guidelines. If our approach is not producing progress, the reports will show it and we will change course with you.
How Do We Write Content That Ranks and Converts?
Search engines and AI systems both look for content that shows real experience and expertise. We write with that in mind, and we involve your team because you know your customers best.

items: One clear purpose per page, matched to what searchers actually want to find.
A direct answer near the top, followed by detail, examples and steps.
Facts checked against reliable sources, with dates where things change.
Input from your experts, and author or reviewer names shown where it builds trust.
Original photos, data or examples from your own work wherever possible.
Clear calls to action, so a visitor who is ready to buy knows what to do next.

main_content.text: We do not mass-produce articles with AI and publish them unchecked. Any drafting tools we use are followed by human editing and fact-checking, because Google judges the quality of content, not how it was produced.
Which Technical Checks Do We Run on Every Site?
Technical problems are often invisible to site owners but obvious to search engines. Every audit by our SEO agency covers:

items: Indexing: pages excluded by mistake, duplicate URLs and canonical tags.
Crawling: robots.txt rules, internal links, orphan pages and redirect chains.
Speed and Core Web Vitals on real visits, especially on mobile.
Mobile layout and content parity between mobile and desktop.
Structured data that matches what is visible on each page.
Server-side rendering of key content on JavaScript-heavy sites.
HTTPS, mixed content and security warnings.
Titles, meta descriptions and headings across the whole site.
XML sitemaps and their status in Search Console.

Links and mentions from other websites still help search engines judge trust, but buying them or trading them in schemes breaks Google's spam policies. We earn them instead.

items: Useful resources such as guides, checklists, calculators or original data that others want to cite.
Digital PR: stories and expert comments offered to relevant journalists and industry sites.
Partnerships with suppliers, associations, events and local organisations you genuinely work with.
Fixing broken or unlinked mentions of your brand.
Accurate listings on reputable business directories relevant to your industry.

main_content.text: As an SEO agency that follows Google's spam policies, we do not use private blog networks, paid link packages, comment spam or mass directory submissions.

Three Typical Situations We Help With
These situations are illustrative. They are based on common requests; names and details are changed, and they are not client case studies or promised results.
Situation 1: A Clinic Missing From the Map Results

A physiotherapy clinic (details changed) appears in searches for its own name but not for "physiotherapy near me". Its business profile lists the wrong category and an old phone number, and its website has one page for all treatments. We would correct the profile, create a page for each main treatment, set up a review request process for real patients and fix the clinic's details on major directories.
Situation 2: A Shopify Store Whose Traffic Fell After a Redesign

A home-decor store (details changed) launched a new theme and lost a large share of search traffic within weeks. Old product URLs return errors and collection pages have no text. We would map and redirect the broken URLs, restore product titles that previously ranked, add helpful collection content and remove apps that slowed the new theme.
Situation 3: A SaaS Product That Only Ranks for Its Own Name

A small HR software company (details changed) gets search traffic only from people who already know its brand. We would build pages for the problems its buyers search for, comparison pages written honestly, integration pages and help articles, then link them from the main navigation and product pages.
Common Mistakes When Hiring an SEO Agency
These mistakes waste budget and sometimes damage a site for years.

items: Choosing a provider because it guarantees rankings or promises page one in weeks.
Paying for links in bulk, which can lead to penalties or links that simply stop counting.
Creating hundreds of near-identical city pages for places where you have no presence.
Opening business profiles at virtual offices or addresses where you do not operate.
Judging success by keyword positions alone instead of enquiries and sales.
Giving an agency full ownership of your Search Console, Analytics or business profile.
Letting search work stop at reports, with nobody to implement the technical fixes.
Copying competitors' content or using AI to mass-produce pages without real expertise.
Redesigning a website without involving the search team, then losing rankings overnight.

main_content.text: Questions to Ask an SEO Agency Before You Sign

Google publishes a list of questions to ask when hiring an SEO, and we recommend using it. It suggests asking for examples of previous work, whether the provider follows Google Search Essentials, what results to expect and in what timeframe, their experience in your industry and location, how long they have been in business, and how they will communicate changes. We add a few of our own:

items: Who will work on my account each month, and what exactly will they do?
How do you earn links, and will you ever buy them?
Will all accounts and content stay in my name?
Who implements technical fixes: you or my developer?
What happens to my content and data if we stop working together?

main_content.text: Questions to Ask Your Developer and Hosting Provider
Search work often depends on other people's systems. Before starting, check:

items: Can the search team get access to edit titles, redirects and structured data, or must every change go through a developer?
Does your hosting support fast response times, HTTPS everywhere and a staging site for testing changes?
Is the site's main content rendered on the server, or only after scripts run in the browser?
Who controls the domain, DNS and email settings needed to verify Search Console?

main_content.text: What This Service Does Not Do
To keep expectations clear, our service does not:

items: Guarantee a ranking position, traffic level or number of leads.
Buy links, use link networks or join link exchanges.
Create doorway pages or fake location pages for cities where you have no real presence.
Open business profiles at virtual offices or false addresses.
Write, buy or incentivise fake reviews.
Publish mass-produced content without expert review.
Claim a special relationship with Google or any search engine.
Keep your accounts or content hostage when the engagement ends.

main_content.text: When You Do Not Need an SEO Agency
We would rather tell you honestly when search optimisation is not the right spend yet.

items: If your business is brand new and you need customers this month, start with paid ads, referrals and direct outreach while the site matures.
If very few people search for what you sell, focus on other channels such as partnerships or sales outreach.
If your website is broken, slow or unclear, fix or rebuild it first; no amount of optimisation can rescue a site that does not convert.
If you have an in-house marketer with time, a one-off audit and training may be all you need.
If you cannot commit to several months of steady work, results will be limited.

main_content.text: Special Cases and Edge Cases
Some situations need extra care. We plan these separately.
Manual Actions and Sudden Traffic Drops

If Search Console shows a manual action, or traffic dropped suddenly, we first find the cause: a spam-policy issue, a core update, a technical change or a seasonal shift. Fixes depend on the cause, and a reconsideration request is filed only after the problem is genuinely solved.
Website Migrations

Changing domain, platform or URL structure is the riskiest moment for search visibility. We map every old URL, set up redirects, keep content that ranks, update internal links and sitemaps, and monitor Search Console closely after launch.
Businesses Serving Many Cities From One Office

If you serve many cities from one office, you can have one genuine business profile, not one per city. City pages on your website should exist only where you have something true and specific to say, such as real projects or service details for that area; otherwise they risk being treated as doorway pages.
Brand-New Websites and Domains

A new domain has no history, reviews or links, so it usually takes longer to gain visibility than an established site. We focus first on a technically clean launch, a small set of excellent pages for your main services, a complete business profile for your real location and early mentions from partners and suppliers. Paid ads or outreach can bring enquiries while organic visibility builds, and we will say plainly if that combination makes more sense for your first months.
Health, Finance and Legal Topics

Pages that can affect people's health, money or safety need especially strong expertise and accuracy. We work with your qualified professionals to review content, show author credentials and cite reliable sources.
Multilingual and International Sites
For sites in several languages or countries, we set up hreflang tags, separate URLs for each language, translated metadata and local business details where they genuinely exist.
Working With Our SEO Agency: What We Need From You
The best results come when the client and the SEO agency work as one team. To keep progress steady, we usually ask for:

items: One contact who can approve content and answer questions within a few working days.
Access to Search Console, Analytics, your business profile and, ideally, the website itself.
Short input from your experts on key topics, so content reflects real experience.
Updates on new services, offers, locations or events that we can use in content.
Permission to request reviews from real customers, using a simple process we set up.

main_content.text: In return, you get a clear monthly plan, visible progress and an SEO agency that explains its decisions in plain language.
About "Best Search Engine Optimization Agency" Lists

You will find many lists ranking the best search engine optimization agency or the top providers of SEO services in India. Treat them with care: some are paid placements, and none can tell you whether a team suits your business. A professional SEO services provider should be able to show real work, explain its plan in plain language and give you references. Whichever SEO service provider you choose, judge it on transparency, not promises. We do not claim a rank; we invite you to check our work. We provide SEO services India-wide from one Bengaluru office, so ask us the same questions you would ask anyone else.

items: A written plan based on an audit, not a generic package.
Technical fixes made by our own developers when you give access.

An SEO agency improves how search engines crawl, understand and trust your website. It fixes technical problems, improves content, manages local listings and earns genuine links so more of the right people find you.

What will your reports show?
Enquiries and sales from organic search, clicks and impressions, technical health, priority keyword positions, business profile actions and the work completed.
Do you offer managed SEO services or only consulting?
Both. Managed SEO services mean we plan and do the work each month; our consulting option provides audits, strategy and training for your own team.
Will I own my accounts and content?
Yes. Search Console, Analytics, your business profile and all content stay in your accounts, and we are added as users.
How much do your SEO services cost?
The total depends on site size and condition, competition, content volume, locations and development time. Our team shares the exact total after reviewing your website and goals.
Do you work with clients outside Bengaluru?
Yes. We have one office in Whitefield, Bengaluru, and work with clients across India and abroad through video calls, shared task lists and monthly reports.

main_content.text: What Is Search Engine Marketing, and How Does Pay-Per-Click Work?

Search engine marketing is the paid side of search. When someone types a query, the search engine runs a quick auction among advertisers who chose related keywords. Where your ad appears and what each click costs depend on your bid and on how relevant and useful the platform judges your ad and landing page to be. You pay only when someone clicks, which is why this model is called pay-per-click.
Good search engine marketing is less about bidding high and more about precision:

items: Keywords that show buying intent, organised into tight groups by theme.
Negative keywords that block irrelevant searches, such as "free", "jobs" or competitor brand names you do not want.
Ads whose headlines echo the search, with clear offers and calls to action.
Landing pages that match the ad, load fast on phones and make the next step obvious.
Conversion tracking, so the platform's bidding learns from real enquiries rather than clicks.

main_content.text: Search Engine Marketing vs SEO

Search engine marketing buys visibility now; SEO earns visibility over time. Paid search is ideal for launches, offers, testing messages and covering searches where you do not rank yet. SEO builds lasting traffic that does not stop when the budget does. Many of our clients use both, and because we offer both, we plan them together so you do not pay for clicks you could earn organically.

Our search engine marketing services cover Google Ads and Microsoft Advertising search campaigns, Shopping campaigns for online stores, and Performance Max campaigns where they fit. As an SEM agency, we start with search campaigns for high-intent queries, because they usually produce the clearest results, then expand into other formats once tracking proves what works.
Social Media Advertising Services

Our social media advertising services run campaigns on Facebook, Instagram and LinkedIn. Social ads reach people based on interests, behaviours, job roles or similarity to your existing customers, which makes them useful for launches, local awareness, events, recruitment and lead forms. Our social media ad services include creative, copy, audience set-up, lead-form design and follow-up automation, and they work best alongside organic social content.
Display, YouTube and Remarketing

Display and YouTube campaigns build awareness and bring back visitors who did not convert the first time. We use them carefully, with frequency limits and placement exclusions, so your budget is not spent on irrelevant apps or sites.
Landing Pages and Tracking

A click is only as good as the page it lands on. Because we are also a web development team, we build fast, focused landing pages and set up conversion tracking ourselves, including call tracking, form submissions, WhatsApp clicks and, where your CRM allows, offline conversions for leads that become customers.
How Do We Structure a Google Ads Account?

Most wasted spend comes from poor structure. A clean account makes it obvious where money goes and what it produces, and it gives the platform's automated bidding clear signals to learn from. Our search engine marketing accounts usually follow these principles:

items: Separate campaigns for each main service or product line, so budgets follow your priorities.
Separate campaigns or settings for each real location or market you serve.
Small, tightly themed ad groups, so each ad speaks directly to the searches it shows for.
Shared negative keyword lists for searches you never want, such as jobs, free, courses or DIY.
Brand and non-brand campaigns kept apart, so brand searches do not hide the true cost of new customers.
Complete assets: sitelinks, callouts, structured snippets, call and location details where relevant.
Ad schedules that match when your team can answer calls and messages.

main_content.text: We document the structure in plain language, so anyone in your team can understand why each campaign exists.
Performance Max, Shopping and Automation: Using Them Wisely

Ad platforms increasingly rely on automation, such as automated bidding and Performance Max campaigns that spread one budget across search, Shopping, YouTube, display and other placements. Automation can work very well, but only when it is fed accurate conversion data, good creative and clear exclusions. Without them, it can spend on low-quality placements and report results that look better than they are. We use automation where the data supports it, review placement and search-term reports where the platform allows, and keep a standard search campaign alongside when you need tighter control.

We target by radius or pin-code areas around your real location, show your address and call button in the ad, schedule ads for hours when someone can answer, and write ads around the specific services people search for nearby.

Local search engine marketing also depends on your Google Business Profile, reviews and website. We check these together, and where organic local visibility can do the job more cheaply, we say so.

main_content.text: Which Rules Affect Your Ads in India?
Ad platforms and Indian law both restrict what can be advertised and how. We check these before launch so campaigns are not rejected or, worse, put your business at risk.

items: Advertiser verification: Google says all advertisers will eventually need to verify their identity or business operations, and its ad disclosures can show the advertiser's name and location. Accounts can be selected earlier, for example in financial services.

Financial services in India: Google requires financial services verification for many financial advertisers in India, enforced from 24 January 2023, with registrations from bodies such as RBI, SEBI and IRDAI accepted as relevant regulators.
Special ad categories on Meta: ads about credit, employment, housing and social issues or politics have restricted targeting options and extra rules.
Online money games: the Promotion and Regulation of Online Gaming Act, 2025 prohibits advertising online money games, with penalties for anyone who publishes or causes such ads. We do not run them.

Health and other claims: health, medicine, education results and financial returns attract strict platform policies and Indian advertising standards, so we ask your compliance team to confirm every claim.

Customer data: uploading customer lists for targeting or using website visitors for remarketing must follow the platforms' rules and India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023, including proper notice and consent.

main_content.text: These rules change, and your legal adviser should confirm what applies to your business. Our part is to set up campaigns that follow the platform policies and the claims you have approved.

Situation 3: A B2B Company With a Long Sales Cycle

We would narrow search terms to purchase intent, add qualifying questions to forms, test LinkedIn ads for decision-makers and feed qualified leads from the CRM back to the platforms so bidding learns from real opportunities.

These mistakes waste most of the money lost in PPC accounts.

Using broad keywords without a negative keyword list.
Sending all ads to the home page instead of a matching landing page.
Letting the agency own the ad account, pixel or customer data.
Judging success by click-through rate or cheap clicks rather than cost per lead and lead quality.
Changing bids and budgets daily during the learning period.

Invalid Clicks and Competitor Clicks

For e-commerce, the product feed is the foundation of Shopping and Performance Max campaigns. Social media marketing services cover the planning, creation and management of a brand's presence on social platforms. Some providers call this SMM services; others separate social media management (running the accounts) from social media marketing (growing reach and results). In practice, most businesses need both, so our offer brings them together.

main_content.text: What Makes a Social Media Content Creation Agency Different?
Templates and stock photos are easy to produce and easy to ignore. As a social media content creation agency, we put most effort into content that only your business could publish.

items: Real people: your team, founders, craftspeople, doctors or engineers explaining what they do.
Real proof: projects, before-and-after results, customer stories shared with permission.
Useful posts: tips, checklists and answers to the questions customers ask before buying.
Short video built for each platform: vertical, captioned, with the point made in the first seconds.
A consistent visual identity, so people recognise your posts before they read your name.
Captions written in your brand's voice, in English, Hindi or regional languages as needed.

main_content.text: We plan content around a few content pillars, for example education, proof, behind the scenes, offers and community, so the feed stays varied without losing focus.
Content Pillars and a Sample Monthly Calendar

A content calendar turns strategy into a routine your audience can rely on. We build each month around three to five content pillars, so the feed stays varied but focused. The example below is illustrative; the real mix depends on your goals and the platforms you use.

rows: Answer questions customers ask before buying
Tip carousels, short explainers, myth-versus-fact posts
Project photos, customer stories with permission, reviews from real buyers
Team introductions, how things are made, a day at work
Drive action at the right time
Launch reels, limited offers, event reminders
Polls, questions, replies to common comments, local events

main_content.text: Each calendar shows dates, platform, format, caption draft, visual reference and the goal of the post. You approve it once, and urgent or reactive posts follow a simple approval rule agreed in advance.
Short Video: Reels, Shorts and What Actually Works
Short vertical video now drives much of the reach on Instagram, YouTube and Facebook. It does not need expensive production, but it does need a clear idea and good editing. Our approach is practical:

items: Open with the point or the most interesting moment, not a logo animation.
Keep one idea per video, and make it understandable with the sound off by adding captions.
Film real work: products in use, a technician fixing something, a chef plating a dish, a founder answering a question.
Use licensed or platform-provided music only.
Edit for each platform's format rather than posting the same file everywhere unchanged.
Repurpose longer videos, talks or webinars into several short clips.

main_content.text: We can shoot on location in Bengaluru by appointment, direct your team to film with a phone, or edit footage you already have.
Social Media Marketing Agency for Small Business

Small businesses rarely have time to post every day, shoot videos and reply to messages. As a social media marketing agency for small business, we keep things simple and practical: a manageable posting rhythm, content that shows your actual work and people, offers tied to your busy and quiet periods, and fast replies to enquiries that come through messages.

Among social media marketing companies for small business, the important difference is focus. We would rather help a clinic, salon, café, showroom or coaching centre win regular bookings from two well-run channels than chase follower counts across five. Where your Google Business Profile, website or WhatsApp follow-up are holding you back, we point that out too, because social attention only pays when the next step works.
Practical Ideas for Local Businesses
Local businesses have an advantage online: real places, real people and real customers nearby. Some ideas that tend to work well for shops, clinics, salons, gyms, restaurants and service providers:

items: Show the space: entrance, parking, waiting area and the team, so first-time visitors know what to expect.
Answer the questions people phone about: prices you are happy to share, timings, how bookings work.
Feature staff and their skills, with their permission.
Share genuine customer moments and reviews, never invented ones.
Tie posts to local events, festivals and seasons that matter to your area.
Always include the next step: call, WhatsApp, book online or visit.

main_content.text: These posts work best when your Google Business Profile, website and phone or WhatsApp replies are equally up to date, because people check several places before deciding.

There are several ways to run social media. The right one depends on your budget, how much content you need and who in your team has time.

A fixed number of posts sold to every client
Real photos and videos of your business
Clear reply hours and escalation rules
Pages and ad accounts in your name

main_content.text: Good social media marketing services should also connect to the rest of your marketing, so attention on social becomes visits, enquiries and sales elsewhere. And the people providing your social media marketing services should be willing to tell you when a channel is not worth the effort.
Social Media Services for One-Off Needs

Not every business needs a monthly retainer. Our social media services also include one-off work: setting up or cleaning up business pages, creating a brand kit for social, producing a launch campaign, training your team, or auditing what is working. These are scoped separately and handed over with simple guides so your team can continue.
LinkedIn for B2B Companies and Founders

For business-to-business companies, LinkedIn is often the most valuable channel, because buyers, partners and future employees spend time there. Company pages work best alongside personal profiles of founders and senior staff, whose posts usually reach more people than the page itself. We help with:

items: Company page set-up, showcase pages where relevant, and consistent branding.
Topic plans for founders and experts, based on their real knowledge and views.
Editing posts, carousels and short videos for their approval.
Employee advocacy guidelines, so team members can share company news comfortably.
Event, webinar and hiring campaigns, measured on sign-ups and applications.

main_content.text: WhatsApp Business and Customer Messages

Many Indian customers move from a social post straight to WhatsApp. We set up WhatsApp Business profiles, quick replies, catalogues and greeting messages, and connect click-to-chat buttons from your posts and website. Promotional messages should go only to people who have agreed to receive them, in line with WhatsApp's policies and India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023. We help design opt-in messages and keep broadcast lists clean, while your team handles the actual conversations or follows the reply rules we agree together.
How Do We Handle Data, Privacy and Consent?

Social media work touches personal information: names in comments, messages, lead forms and customer lists used for ads. We keep it simple and careful. Access to your accounts is given through each platform's business roles, not shared passwords. Lead-form data goes straight to you or your CRM. Customer lists are used for targeting only when your notices and consent allow it. And when a team member leaves, access is removed the same day.
How Do Paid Social Ads Fit With Organic Posting?

Organic posts build trust with people who already follow you, but most platforms show unpaid posts to only a fraction of followers. Paid campaigns extend reach to new people who match your customers, retarget people who visited your website and support launches, events and offers. We usually recommend a small, steady paid budget alongside organic content once the page has enough good posts to impress new visitors. Detailed campaign management sits with our paid ads team.
Influencer Collaborations and the Rules in India

Influencer partnerships can help a brand reach new audiences, but they come with clear rules. The Department of Consumer Affairs' "Endorsement Know-hows!" guide, released in January 2023, says influencers must disclose any material connection with a brand, such as payment, free products, trips or discounts, clearly and prominently within the post, using simple labels such as "advertisement", "sponsored" or "paid promotion". In August 2023, the Advertising Standards Council of India (ASCI) added that health and finance influencers must hold relevant qualifications or registrations, such as SEBI registration for investment advice, and show them prominently.

When we plan influencer work, we check that creators disclose partnerships properly, that claims about your product are true and approved by you, and that health or finance content is handled only by qualified voices. Your legal adviser should confirm what applies to your category.
Growing the Right Audience, Not Just More Followers
A large following of the wrong people is worth less than a small following of likely customers. We focus growth on quality:

items: Content aimed at specific customer problems, not generic trends.
Collaborations with genuine local partners, suppliers and complementary brands.
Paid promotion targeted at people similar to your real customers, when budgets allow.
Clear profile information: what you do, where you serve and how to contact you.
Consistent replies, which encourage more people to comment and share.

main_content.text: We watch who is following and engaging, not just how many, and adjust content when the audience drifts away from the customers you want.
Accessible and Inclusive Posts

Good posts work for everyone. We add captions to videos, write descriptive alt text where platforms allow it, keep text on images short and readable, use strong colour contrast and avoid putting important information only in small print. Inclusive content also reaches people who scroll with the sound off or in bright sunlight, which is most people at some point.
What We Need From You

The best social content comes from inside the business. To keep the calendar running smoothly, we usually ask for one person who can approve the monthly plan, regular access to your team or products for photos and short videos, quick notice of offers, events and launches, and clear rules about which customer questions or complaints must go to a senior person. With those in place, the work runs with very little of your time each week.
What Will You See in Our Social Media Reports?
Likes are pleasant, but they are not the goal. Our reports start with business outcomes and then explain the signals behind them.

People moving from interest to action
How many people saw your content

Keeping Up With Platform Changes

Platforms change features, formats and algorithms regularly. A format that worked last year can lose reach today. We review platform announcements and our own clients' results each month, test new formats on a small scale before shifting the whole calendar, and explain any change in approach in the monthly report. That way your plan adapts steadily instead of chasing every trend.

We do not publish fixed fees on this page, because social media needs vary widely. The total for any plan depends on:

items: Number of platforms and posts per month on each.
Content mix: static posts, carousels, stories, reels or long videos.
Shoots: whether we shoot on location, edit your footage or design from existing assets.
Community management hours and expected message volume.
Languages: English only or additional Indian languages.
Paid social: management of campaigns, with ad spend paid directly by you to the platforms.

Three Typical Situations We Help With
These situations are illustrative. They are based on common requests; names and details are changed, and they are not client case studies or promised results.
Situation 1: A Café With Followers but Few Visits

A neighbourhood café (details changed) has a pretty Instagram feed but quiet weekday afternoons. We would plan reels around weekday offers and new menu items, add location tags and opening hours to every post, reply quickly to messages about table bookings and track redemptions of a social-only offer at the counter.
Situation 2: A B2B Firm Invisible on LinkedIn

An engineering consultancy (details changed) has a company page with occasional job posts and no clear voice. We would build a LinkedIn plan around project stories, short explainers from senior engineers and the founder's perspective on industry changes, posting from both the company page and key people's profiles with their approval.
Situation 3: A Skincare Brand Planning Influencer Launches

A new skincare brand (details changed) wants to work with creators for its launch. We would shortlist creators whose audiences match, brief them with approved claims only, check that every post carries a clear paid-partnership disclosure, and measure results with tracked links and discount codes rather than reach alone.
Common Mistakes in Social Media Marketing
These mistakes waste effort and sometimes damage a brand's reputation.

items: Trying to be on every platform at once and doing none of them well.
Posting without goals, so nobody knows whether social is working.
Using only stock images and templates that look like every competitor.
Ignoring comments and messages, or replying days later.
Buying followers or engagement, which damages reach and trust.
Letting a freelancer or agency own your page, ad account or login.
Running influencer posts without clear paid-partnership disclosure.
Making claims about health, finance or results that the business cannot prove.
Judging success by follower count alone.

Ask any provider these questions, including us. Clear written answers are a good sign.

main_content.text: Special Cases and Edge Cases
Some brands need extra planning. We treat these separately.
Restarting a Dormant Page

Many businesses have pages that have not posted for months or years, sometimes with old phone numbers and unanswered reviews. We start by fixing profile details, replying to old reviews and messages where it still makes sense, removing outdated offers and pinning a fresh introduction post. If you lose access to a page, recovery depends on the platform's own process and on who was listed as an admin. We help gather proof of ownership and follow the official recovery steps, and afterwards we set up two-step login and business-level admin roles so it does not happen again.

Healthcare, finance, education and legal services face strict advertising standards and platform policies. We plan content with your compliance team, avoid unproven claims and make sure qualified people speak on specialist topics.
Crisis or Negative Comments

main_content.text: Logos, Brand Identity and Interfaces From Our UI UX Design Services
Branding, graphic and interface work planned, crafted and handed over in full by one team in Bengaluru.

UI UX design services shape how a product looks (user interface, or UI) and how easy it is to use (user experience, or UX), for websites, apps and software. Branding gives a business a recognisable name, logo, colours and voice. Afwan Tech offers branding, graphic work and UI UX design services from Whitefield, Bengaluru, and because our developers sit in the same team, the screens we draw are the screens that get built.

Good visual work is not decoration. A clear identity helps customers remember you; a clear interface helps them finish what they came to do, whether that is booking, buying or asking a question. We start from your customers and goals, test ideas early with real people, and hand over source files, guidelines and full ownership in writing, so your brand is never locked inside an agency's folders.

main_content.text: Who Do We Work With?
Our branding and interface clients range from first-time founders to established companies. Typical projects come from:

items: Startups that need a credible identity and a first version of their app or web product.
Small businesses refreshing a logo, signage and website at the same time.
Software companies whose product grew feature by feature and now feels inconsistent.
Manufacturers and B2B firms that need catalogues, presentations and a clearer website.
Clinics, schools and service providers that want booking and enquiry journeys to be easier.
Marketing teams that need a steady supply of on-brand templates and campaign graphics.

main_content.text: Each group needs a different balance of research, visual work and documentation, so we shape the scope around your stage rather than selling one fixed package.
Our Design Principles
A few principles guide every project, whatever its size:

items: Start with people: understand who will use the brand or product before choosing colours or layouts.
Clarity beats cleverness: if a visitor has to think about how something works, it needs simplifying.
Consistency builds trust: the same patterns, words and visuals everywhere.
Accessible by default: contrast, readable text and usable controls from the first draft.
Build what can be maintained: work your team can update without us.

main_content.text: What Is the Difference Between UI, UX, Branding and Graphic Work?
The terms overlap, and many providers use them loosely. This table shows how we separate them, so you can choose what you actually need.

rows: Who are you, and how should people recognise and remember you?
Name support, logo, colours, typography, voice, brand guidelines
How do we communicate one message well in a format?
Social posts, brochures, ads, presentations, packaging, signage files
Can people find what they need and complete tasks easily?
Research, journeys, sitemaps, wireframes, prototypes, test findings
How should each screen look and behave?
Screen layouts, components, states, interactions, design systems

main_content.text: Many projects need more than one: a startup may need branding first, then UI and UX for its app; an established company may only need its dashboard redesigned. We scope each part separately so you pay only for what helps.
Our UI UX Design Services, Step by Step

Our UI UX design services follow a simple principle, whether the product is a website, an app or internal software: understand before drawing, and test before building. The amount of each step depends on the size of the project.
UX Design Services: Research and Structure

Our UX design services start by learning how people actually use your product or would like to. That can mean short interviews with customers or staff, reviewing support questions, studying analytics, and looking at competitors' journeys. From there we map user journeys, decide what goes on each screen and organise navigation so people find things where they expect them.
Wireframes and Prototypes

Wireframes are simple grey layouts that show structure without colours or images, so discussion stays on content and flow. Once agreed, we turn key journeys into clickable prototypes that feel like the real thing. We test these with a handful of real users, because five people trying a prototype will reveal most of the obvious problems before any code is written.
UI Design Services: Screens, Components and States

Our UI design services turn approved wireframes into finished screens. We design every state a developer needs: empty screens, loading, errors, success messages, disabled buttons and long text. Reusable components, such as buttons, forms, cards and tables, are documented once and used everywhere, which keeps the product consistent and speeds up development.
Design Systems for Growing Products

For products that will keep growing, we create a design system: a shared library of colours, typography, spacing rules and components, with guidance on when to use each. It lets your team add new screens without reinventing the basics, and it keeps several developers or designers aligned.
Dashboards and Data-Heavy Interfaces

Dashboards, admin panels and reporting tools carry a lot of information, and people use them for hours. Good UI UX design services for these products focus on clarity over decoration: the most important numbers first, consistent tables with sorting and filters, clear status colours that do not rely on colour alone, sensible defaults and keyboard-friendly forms. We design with real data, including long names and empty states, so the screens still work on day one hundred, not just in a polished demo.
Mobile App Interfaces: Android and iOS Conventions

Mobile users expect apps to behave like the other apps on their phone. We respect each platform's conventions for navigation, gestures, back behaviour, system fonts and permission prompts, while keeping your brand recognisable. Thumb reach, one-handed use, offline states and slow networks shape the layouts. For cross-platform apps, our UI UX design services define where the two platforms should look the same and where each should feel native.
UX Audits for Existing Websites and Apps

Not every product needs a redesign. Often a focused review finds a handful of problems that block most users. A UX audit is one of the most cost-effective UI UX design services we offer, because it tells you exactly where to spend effort. It usually covers:

items: Analytics review: where people drop off in key journeys such as sign-up, checkout or enquiry.
Heuristic review: established usability principles applied screen by screen.
Accessibility checks against WCAG 2.2 for contrast, focus, labels and target sizes.
Content clarity: headings, buttons and error messages that confuse people.
Mobile behaviour on real phones, including slow connections.
A short list of fixes ranked by impact and effort, with annotated screenshots.

main_content.text: Your own team can carry out the fixes, or ours can, and we can measure the before-and-after results together.
Designing for Conversion: Landing Pages and Forms
Small interface details decide whether visitors become customers. For landing pages, booking flows and enquiry forms, we focus on:

items: One clear message and one main action per page.
Forms that ask only for what you need, with helpful labels and inline validation.
Trust shown near the decision point: real reviews, guarantees you can honour, contact details.
Fast, light layouts that load quickly on ordinary phones.
Buttons that say what happens next, such as "Book a call" rather than "Submit".

main_content.text: These principles apply to every interface we create, and they are a large part of why businesses come to us for UI UX design services rather than templates.
UI UX Design and Development Services in One Team

Many interface projects go wrong at the handover between designer and developer. The design looks good in a presentation, then gets changed during development because it was impractical, too slow or missing states. Our UI UX design and development services avoid that gap: designers and developers review layouts together from the wireframe stage, so what we show you is realistic to build and fast to load.

rows: Designer hands over screens; developer interprets them
Gaps, compromises and extra rounds of changes
Developers check feasibility and performance during design
Fewer surprises; build matches the approved design
Works, but often inconsistent and harder to use

main_content.text: Our UI UX development services also cover front-end component builds that match the design system exactly, so the code and the files stay in step.
Branding: Building an Identity People Remember
As a branding provider, we help new and growing businesses look consistent and credible wherever customers meet them. A brand identity project usually includes:

items: Discovery: your customers, competitors, values, personality and what makes you different.
Positioning: a short statement of who you serve and why they should choose you.
Logo: concepts based on the discovery, refined into a primary logo and versions for small sizes, dark backgrounds and icons.
Colour palette and typography chosen for readability, accessibility and personality.
Brand voice: how you sound in writing, with examples of words to use and avoid.
Imagery style: guidance for photos, illustrations and icons.
Brand guidelines: a document your team, printers and future partners can follow.
Starter assets: business cards, letterhead, email signature, social templates and presentation templates.

main_content.text: Logos, Trademarks and Ownership

A logo is also a business asset you may want to protect. Before finalising, a trademark attorney should search existing registrations and advise whether your name and logo can be filed with India's Trade Marks Registry. We are not trademark agents, but we prepare the final artwork in the formats an application needs and avoid designs that copy existing marks.

Ownership is just as important. Under India's Copyright Act, 1957, an assignment of copyright must be in writing, and it should state the rights, duration and territory; if the duration is not stated, it is presumed to be five years, and if the territory is not stated, it is presumed to cover India only. That is why our agreements assign the final, approved work to you in writing, worldwide and without a time limit, and why we hand over the editable source files.
What Makes a Good Logo?

Logo design is about recognition, not decoration. A good logo works at the size of an app icon and on the side of a building, in one colour and in full colour, on light and dark backgrounds. We judge logo concepts against a few practical tests:

items: Is it simple enough to recognise at a glance and to remember?
Does it still work in black and white and at very small sizes?
Is it distinct from competitors and from existing registered marks?
Does it suit the people you want to attract, rather than only the founders' taste?
Will it age well, or is it tied to a passing trend?

main_content.text: We present each concept on real applications, such as a shop sign, a phone screen, a social profile and packaging, so you can judge it in context rather than on a blank page.
Working With Your Brand Guidelines Day to Day

Guidelines only help if people use them. We keep brand guidelines short and practical, with clear dos and don'ts, ready-to-use templates for common needs and a shared folder of approved logos, colours and fonts. When your team or another agency creates something new, they start from the same building blocks.
Colour, Typography and Imagery Choices

Colour and type do more work than people expect. We choose a palette with enough contrast for text and buttons, a limited set of accent colours for emphasis and clear rules for backgrounds. Typography is chosen for readability on screens and in print, with licensed fonts that support any Indian scripts you need. Imagery guidelines describe the kind of photos, illustrations and icons that fit the brand, so future content looks consistent even when created by different people. Each choice is tested on real applications, from a phone screen to a printed brochure, before it is finalised.
Branding and Web Design Together

A new identity often needs a new website, and a new website often reveals that the brand is not ready. Planning branding and web design together means the colours, type and imagery are chosen with screens in mind, and the website launches with a consistent look from day one. As a branding and digital marketing agency, we can also carry the identity into social media templates, ad creative and email designs, so every channel feels like the same company.

Graphic Design Services in India: Working With Us Remotely

We provide graphic design services in India and abroad from one office in Whitefield, Bengaluru. Most work happens through video calls, shared design files with comments, and a clear review schedule. Clients in Bengaluru can meet us in person by appointment for workshops or reviews. We do not have branch offices in other cities, and we do not claim local studios where we have none.

Working remotely is straightforward when feedback is organised. We share designs in a tool where you can comment directly on the screen or artwork, collect everyone's feedback in one round, and confirm decisions in writing before moving on.
What Files Will You Receive at Handover?
A design project is only finished when your team can use and change the work without us. Typical handover packages include:

How Do We Measure Whether a Redesign Worked?

A redesign should be judged by results, not by opinions in a meeting. Before starting, we agree on a few measures, such as completion rate of a key journey, time to finish a task, number of support questions about a feature, sign-up or enquiry conversion, or app store review themes. We record a baseline, redesign, release and compare. When results are mixed, we look at recordings, feedback and analytics to understand why, then adjust. This is part of how our UI UX design services stay focused on outcomes that matter to your business.

Every project follows a similar order, scaled to its size.

main_content.text: How Do We Make Interfaces Accessible?

Accessible interfaces work for more people, including those with low vision, colour blindness, limited dexterity or temporary difficulties such as a cracked screen or bright sunlight. We follow WCAG 2.2, which became a W3C Recommendation on 6 October 2023 and added nine new success criteria. In our UI work that means:

items: Text and interface colours with enough contrast, and meaning never shown by colour alone.
Visible focus states for keyboard users and clear labels on every form field.
Tap and click targets large enough to hit easily, with space between them.
Layouts that still work when users enlarge text.
Error messages that explain what went wrong and how to fix it.
Motion that can be reduced for people sensitive to animation.

main_content.text: We check designs during reviews and again in the built product with developers, but we do not issue legal accessibility certificates.

Design system depth and documentation.
Print or packaging items and file formats needed.
Third-party costs, such as licensed fonts, stock images or photography, paid directly or passed through at cost with your approval.

Three Typical Situations We Help With
These situations are illustrative. They are based on common requests; names and details are changed, and they are not client case studies or promised results.
Situation 1: A Startup With an App and No Brand

A two-founder health-booking startup (details changed) has a working app built with default colours and a placeholder logo. Investors and users find it hard to trust. We would run a short brand discovery, create a logo and palette that work on small app icons, update the app's UI with a component library and give the founders social and pitch-deck templates in the same style.
Situation 2: A Dashboard Staff Avoid Using

A logistics company (details changed) built an internal dashboard that staff find confusing, so they keep using spreadsheets. We would interview the people who use it daily, map their main tasks, redesign the navigation and key screens, test a prototype with a few staff members and hand our developers or theirs a clear specification.
Situation 3: A Family Business Refreshing a Decades-Old Identity

A family-run sweets brand (details changed) has a logo that looks dated and prints badly on new packaging. We would keep the recognisable elements customers love, modernise the lettering and colours, create a packaging system for different product lines and prepare print-ready files with physical proofs approved before production.
Common Mistakes in Branding and Interface Projects
These mistakes waste time and money, and some are hard to undo.

items: Choosing a logo by committee vote instead of against agreed goals and audience.
Skipping a trademark search, then having to rebrand after launch.
Accepting only flat image files, with no editable source files or written ownership.
Designing app screens without the developers who will build them.
Testing designs only with the internal team instead of real customers or users.
Ignoring accessibility, which excludes users and causes rework later.
Using unlicensed fonts, images or icons that create legal risk.
Creating a beautiful identity with no guidelines, so it is applied inconsistently.
Redesigning a working interface for looks alone, confusing existing users.

To keep expectations clear, our branding and UI UX service does not:

items: Copy another company's logo, interface or brand style.

We would rather tell you honestly when a full branding or UI UX project is not the right spend.

items: If you are still validating whether customers want your product, a simple, clean starter identity may be enough for now.
If your interface works well and users are happy, small targeted improvements beat a full redesign.
If you only need a one-off flyer or social post, a single graphics task is better value than a brand project.
If you have an in-house designer, a review or design-system workshop may be all you need.
If your business name may change soon, wait before investing in a full identity.

main_content.text: Special Cases and Edge Cases
Some projects need extra planning. We treat these separately.
Rebranding an Established Business

Changing a known brand carries risk: customers, staff and partners have expectations. We plan a phased rollout, keep recognisable elements where possible and prepare a checklist of every place the old brand appears, from signage to email signatures.
Multilingual and Indian-Script Branding

Brands used in Hindi, Kannada, Tamil, Telugu or other scripts need lettering that works in each script, not just a translated name. We design logo lockups and typography pairings for each language you need.
Regulated Products and Packaging

Food, health, cosmetics and other regulated products have mandatory label information. We design around the content your compliance team provides and leave the required text and sizes to their approval.
Interfaces for Low-Literacy or First-Time Users
Some products serve people who are new to smartphones or prefer icons and voice. We use simple language, recognisable icons, larger targets and test with representative users.
Taking Over Someone Else's Design Files
If a previous designer has left, we review what files exist, rebuild missing source files where needed and organise everything into a usable library before new work starts.

main_content.text: Frequently Asked Questions About Our UI UX Design Services
What are UI UX design services?
UI UX design services plan how a website, app or software looks and how easy it is to use. They include research, journeys, wireframes, prototypes, screen layouts and design systems.
What is the difference between UI and UX?
UX is about how easily people can complete tasks; UI is about how each screen looks and behaves. Good products need both working together.
Do you also offer branding?
Yes. We create logos, colour palettes, typography, brand voice, guidelines and starter assets, and we can carry the identity into websites, apps and marketing.
What is included in your graphic design services list?
Social and ad creative, presentations, brochures, catalogues, packaging and label layouts, signage files, infographics and report layouts, each available alone or in a brand project.
Do you test designs with real users?
Yes, where the project allows. We test clickable prototypes with a small number of real users to find problems before development begins.
Will I own the final designs?
Yes. Copyright in the final approved work is assigned to you in writing, worldwide and without a time limit, and we hand over editable source files.
Why does the assignment need to be in writing?
Under India's Copyright Act, an assignment of copyright must be in writing, and missing details on duration or territory are presumed to limit it, so a clear written assignment protects you.
Can you help register my logo as a trademark?
We prepare the artwork, but a trademark attorney should run searches and file the application with India's Trade Marks Registry.
Do you design interfaces that developers can build?
Yes. Our developers review designs from the wireframe stage, and we provide components, states and specifications so the build matches the design.
Can your team also build the website or app?
Yes. Our UI UX design and development services cover both, or we hand clean specifications to your own developers.
Do you follow accessibility guidelines?
Yes. We design to WCAG 2.2 for contrast, focus, labels, text size and tap targets, and check again in the built product.
Do you use licensed fonts and images?
Always. Fonts, images and icons are licensed for your use, and any paid licences are agreed with you before purchase.
How many logo concepts and revisions are included?
The number is set in the written proposal based on scope, so you know exactly what to expect before work starts.
How long does a branding or UI UX project take?
It depends on scope, number of screens or assets, research and feedback speed. We give an indicative schedule by stage in the proposal.
How much do your UI UX and branding services cost?
The total depends on scope, concepts, screens, research, design system depth, print items and licences. Our team shares the exact total after reviewing your requirements.
Do you work with clients outside Bengaluru?
Yes. We have one office in Whitefield, Bengaluru, and work with clients across India and abroad through video calls and shared design files.

bottom_content.text: Branding, Graphics and UI UX Design Services From One Team

**Afwan Tech** offers branding, graphic work and UI UX design services from one office in Whitefield, Bengaluru, for businesses across India and abroad. We start with your customers and goals, test ideas with real people where possible, and hand over editable source files with ownership assigned to you in writing. Because our developers work in the same team, the interfaces we draw are realistic to build and fast to load.

Our UX design services cover research interviews, user journeys, sitemaps, wireframes, clickable prototypes and usability tests. Our UI design services turn approved structure into finished screens with every state a developer needs, and for growing products we create a design system so new screens stay consistent. When you need both planning and code, our UI UX design and development services and UI UX development services carry the work from first sketch to a working website, app or dashboard. Smaller needs, such as a UX audit of an existing product, are available as focused UI UX services too.

As a branding provider, we create logos, colour palettes, typography, brand voice and practical guidelines, then apply them to business cards, presentations, social templates and packaging. Planning branding and web design together means a new identity and a new website launch with one consistent look. As a branding and digital marketing agency, we can also carry the identity into ad creative, social posts and email.

Our graphic design services list covers social and ad creative, pitch decks, brochures, catalogues, packaging and label layouts, signage files and infographics, each available on its own or as part of a brand project. We provide graphic design services in India and abroad through video calls and shared files with comments, and clients in Bengaluru can meet us by appointment. Choosing a graphic design business, a freelancer or an in-house designer depends on how much you need and how often; we explain the trade-offs honestly.

Ownership matters. Under India's Copyright Act, 1957, an assignment of copyright must be in writing and should state duration and territory, or it is presumed to last five years and cover India only. That is why our agreements assign final, approved work to you in writing, worldwide and without a time limit. For trademark protection, a trademark attorney should search and file your logo with India's Trade Marks Registry; we prepare the artwork they need.

Accessibility is built in, following WCAG 2.2 for contrast, labels, focus states, text size and tap targets. We use only licensed fonts, images and icons, never copy other brands' work, and never hold back your files.

Every brand identity project tests logo design concepts on real applications, from app icons to shop signs, and every interface project measures user experience against goals agreed before work starts, such as task completion, enquiry conversion or fewer support questions. That way decisions rest on evidence, not only on taste.

How a project runs is simple: a discovery call, a written proposal with concepts, revision rounds and the exact total, research, concepts, refinement, testing, final files and a handover session. Pricing for each project is shared after we review your requirements.
